description: This file defines a controller class 'HolidayController' within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and uses traits to handle leave period services. It mainly prepares data related to leave periods for rendering a 'holiday-list' component in the front-end, indicating its role in managing holiday-related functionalities within the HRM system.

classes.name: HolidayController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling holiday-related views and data in the OrangeHRM leave module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave period data and sets up the front-end component for holiday listing before rendering.
